notes: Fiscal year ended December 27, 2025. Filings: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0000050863-26-000011, filed January 23, 2026) and the 2026 proxy statement (accession 0000050863-26-000061, filed March 23, 2026), both read on www.sec.gov. GORDON MOORE is deceased. The 2026 proxy's ownership tables list only directors, NEOs and three 5% holders; the word 'Moore' does not appear in the proxy, and in the 10-K it appears only as Moore's Law. No Moore estate, trust or foundation holding is disclosed, so family is null. HOLDERS: new this year is the U.S. government (Department of Commerce), whose shares are in the name of the Department of Commerce (the 10-K attributes proceeds from the U.S. government to common stock, warrants and Escrowed Shares issued in 2025); its 8.4% assumes the full release of shares held in escrow under the Secure Enclave program. Vanguard's 8.1% is as of December 31, 2025 (13G/A filed January 30, 2026). BlackRock's 6.8% rests on a 13G/A filed January 25, 2024, which conflicts with the table's December 31, 2025 date, so its asOf is null. The proxy does not state the share count behind the percentages. BUYBACKS: zero; the 10-K says the last repurchase was in Q1 2021. DIVIDENDS: none paid in 2025 (suspended from Q4 2024). STOCK COMP: the $2,434 million cash-flow add-back. GEOGRAPHY: by customer billing location; the United States overtook China as the largest region in 2025.
